title: Bootstrap productdb integration members outside production migrations
decision: Production migrations no longer create system or admin member fixtures or use an all-zero member UUID. Disposable integration databases run an explicit idempotent seed command after migrations; storefront and public product fixtures resolve root@gmail.com by email.
rationale: Fresh productdb CI instances need the public root sentinel before the isolated-schema harness starts, while production migration streams must not contain test accounts. Nullable product ownership removes the invalid all-zero foreign-key dependency without changing variant-based inventory linkage.
risk: The integration and storefront bootstrap commands must run after the full migration set and against the intended disposable database. The existing explicit productdb URL guard remains unchanged.
